title: Ordinary flat quotient comparisons and adjunction mates
statement: Let $Y,S$ be Noetherian schemes, $f:X\to Y$ proper and $g:S\to Y$ flat [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $J$ and $I$ be quasi-coherent ideal sheaves with $J.\operatorname{comap}(g)=I$. Put $Z=X\times_Y S$, $q:Z\to X$, $p:Z\to S$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Fix an adjunction $a:f^*\dashv f_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], a coherent formal $J$-system $G$, a coherent module $F$ on $X$, and an isomorphism $\beta:G\circ f^*\simeq F^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose a coherent formal $I$-system $G_0$ and a coherent module $F_0$ on $Z$ are supplied with $h_G:G_0=G\circ g^*$ and $F_0=q^*F$. Then there are an adjunction $a_R:p^*\dashv p_*$, an isomorphism $\beta_0:G_0\circ p^*\simeq F_0^\wedge$, an ordinary-module isomorphism $b:p_*F_0\simeq g^*f_*F$, and a system map $t:(F^\wedge\circ f_*)\circ g^*\to F_0^\wedge\circ p_*$ such that, for every $n\ge0$, writing $\pi_n$ for the quotient by the $(n+1)$st ideal power, $b\,g^*(f_*\pi_n)\,t_n=p_*\pi_{0,n}$ and $\operatorname{eqToHom}(h_G)_n\,g^*(\eta^a_{G_n}f_*\beta_n)\,t_n=\eta^{a_R}_{G_{0,n}}p_*\beta_{0,n}$. This statement involves only the ordinary pushforward $f_*F$ and its pullback, not completion of that pushforward or any map out of it.

proof.text: Use degree-zero flat base change and its section formula to obtain the natural adjunction mate g*f_*M to p_*q*M, invertible on quasi-coherent M. Identify the exchanged fibre-product models via their symmetry. Apply its inverse at F and identify F zero = q*F to obtain the ordinary isomorphism b.

Pull beta through the pullback-composition comparison and the completion-pullback comparison. Choose a tensor-pullback adjunction on p and compare the given adjunction on f with the adjunction used in base change; absorb the resulting left-adjoint automorphism into the composition comparison to obtain beta zero. Whisker the base-change map on the quotient system with the inverse completion-pullback comparison for F to define t.

Naturality of the base-change map at F to its quotient, together with the quotient-projection equation of completion pullback, gives b times the pulled pushforward projection times t = p_* of the new projection. The base-change mate equation, naturality at beta and the adjusted pullback composition comparison give the unit equation. The comparisons are natural in the level, so t and beta zero are maps of systems. Zero and unit ideals, zero modules, and empty schemes satisfy the same cokernel identities.

lean.statement: theorem formal_flat_quotient_mate_data {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian S] (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (g : S ⟶ Y) [Flat g] (I : S.IdealSheafData) (hI : J.comap g = I) (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X) (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅ formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj) (G₀ : CoherentFormalModule S I) (F₀ : CoherentModules (pullback f g)) (hG : G₀.obj = G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g) (hF : F₀.obj = (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F.obj) : let p := pullback.snd f g ∃ (adjR : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p) (β₀ : G₀.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ≅ formalCompletionSystem (I.comap p) F₀.obj) (b : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj ≅ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj)) (t : (formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g ⟶ formalCompletionSystem (I.comap p) F₀.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p), (∀ n : ℕ, b.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj)) ≫ t.app (op n) = (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map (formalModuleQuotientπ (I.comap p) (n + 1) F₀.obj)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (eqToHom hG).app (op n) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).map (adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n))) ≫ t.app (op n) = adjR.unit.app (G₀.obj.obj (op n)) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map (β₀.hom.app (op n)))
